new.name: cve-2026-104099-fabio-path-acl-bypass
new.description: CVE-2026-104099 - Fabio - Critical 9.1 - Remote - Path-equivalence ACL bypass. Fabio selects the route from the raw unnormalized path, so /./admin/, /%2e/admin/, //admin/ and /x/../admin/ miss the protected route, skip its allow/auth gate, and the backend serves the protected page. Loopback lab, 1.7.2 vulnerable, 1.7.3 fixed.
